status: Functional checks passed; bounded capture evidence, not comprehensive leak certification
authorization: User authorized real testing and manually disconnected/reconnected the same VPN twice.

isolation.library: Temporary library under .build/ikev2-test; production library and preferences untouched
isolation.dns: 1.1.1.1 via interface-bound TCP; not the system loopback resolver
isolation.execution: Native Rust engine; real IKEv2 test did not exercise the signed XPC/UI path

capture.method: 64-byte snaplen captures on physical en0 and tunnel ipsec0; engine sockets sampled approximately every 0.5 seconds
capture.tunnelCaptureEnded: Interface disappeared at disconnect; no tunnel capture of the reconnect stage
capture.physicalCaptureSpanned: Connected download, disconnect, blocked interval, reconnect and resumed download
capture.interpretation: No physical packets matched sampled engine TCP endpoints or UDP local ports. Tunnel capture contained matching engine traffic and bound TCP DNS. Other physical UDP DNS traffic was observed and cannot be process-attributed with this capture method.

fix.problem: The Settings picker filtered only utun interfaces and hid the active IKEv2 ipsec0 interface

limitations: Process-filtered pktap capture failed with Operation not permitted. Basic physical/tunnel captures succeeded.
The first round lacks a valid pre-disconnect capture; do not use it for leak claims.
Socket sampling can miss short-lived connections, especially before sampling began. Captures are supporting evidence, not exhaustive process attribution.
Only IPv4 traffic was observed; IPv6 was not validated.

Kill-switch and split-tunnel policy were not independently established. Physical DNS request/reply traffic continued while the engine was blocked, but this does not prove every direct path was available.
Sleep/wake, network switching, interface reuse and VPN failures that leave the interface present remain untested.
Real-network native UI interaction and signed-XPC integration remain separate from these core-engine checks.

finalState.vpn: User reconnected; test resumed payload before exiting
finalState.engine: Both isolated probe runs exited successfully
finalState.temporaryIntegrationTest: Archived under .build, outside automatic Cargo test discovery
